script_text: A cosmic collision in your finance sector shakes your world this week, Taurus. Monday through Wednesday, Venus, your ruling planet, squares Pluto in your 8th House while the Sun opposes Uranus in your 10th House of career. Monday is your worst day—expect power struggles over money. Wednesday improves as the Moon trines Venus in your 2nd House of income. Thursday marks the shift when Mercury enters Sagittarius and sextiles Saturn in your 6th House, shifting focus to practical routines. Friday through Sunday, Venus conjuncts Jupiter in your 5th House of love and creativity, sparking romance. Your weekend glows with Earth stability, perfect for dating or signing a creative contract. Friday is your power day because Venus conjuncts Jupiter in your 5th House. Monday is your danger day due to the Venus-Pluto square in your 8th House. Review financial documents before signing anything this week. Follow for daily updates.
